rationale: The agent did authenticate the user via name and ZIP and retrieved user details. However, it executed multiple order-changing write actions—cancelling order #W9373487, modifying items on #W5481803, and initiating a return on #W7449508—without any explicit user confirmation shown, violating the policy requirement to confirm before writes and disregarding the user’s preference to do one thing at a time. There is also no clear evidence that the agent provided the tablet’s tracking number or properly addressed the request to refund or reorder the lost tablet (and no handoff/escalation when that appears not directly supported). While actions taken may align with some of the user’s intents (cancel charger, cancel boot/keep kettle, return sneaker), the lack of confirmation and incomplete handling of the tablet issue means the request was not completed in line with policy.
